title: Accessible Safari: Travelling With Limited Mobility
excerpt: With limited mobility, a safari in Tanzania is possible with good planning. What to consider about vehicles, lodges and flights.
body:
A safari is largely spent in a vehicle, which makes it accessible for many travellers with limited mobility.

## Vehicles

Standard safari vehicles have a high step. Some operators have vehicles with a lift or ramp. Ask us what is available.

## Lodges

Not every lodge is accessible. Some have rooms on ground level, wider doors and accessible bathrooms. Tented camps often have paths and steps.

## Flights

Small aircraft can be difficult to board. Discuss this in advance.

## Pace

Fewer locations, longer stays.

## Planning

Tell us exactly what you need. We check with our partner and lodges before we propose a route.

## Honest

Not everything is possible everywhere, and we will tell you that openly.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
